zh:
\2【沾滿污泥的男子：阿雄】\F
\s　　事實上\o，\w\s這個地牢整個全給四通八達的地下水道圍
　得水洩不通\o。\w\s所以嚴格說來，任何人是沒有辦法進入
　這個地方的\o。\u\k\c\s　　應該說\o，\w\s這監牢是故意設計成不讓水道中到處遊走的
　怪物可以侵入的結構\o。\w\s
　　但有時候為了消滅這些可怕的怪物，守衛們也會下去
　水道中戰鬥\o…。\w\s唉呀呀\o、\w\s沾著泥巴好癢好癢\o。\s\e
en:
\2Hsiung, the Mud-Caked Man:\F
\s  Truth is, this whole dungeon is boxed in by
 sewers running every which way.\w\s So strictly
 speaking, nobody can get in here.\u\k\c\s  Or rather, it was built so the monsters
 roaming the sewers can't get in.\w\s Though the
 guards go down to fight them now and then...\w\s
 Ugh, this mud itches like mad.\s\e

zh: \2【身上只裹著件薄衣服的女子：愛麗莎】\F\n\s　　這裡的怪物翻臉跟翻書一樣\o。\w\s有時候跟監牢的守衛\n　還處得好好的\o，\w\s沒一會兒就又殺過來砍過去的了\o。\s\e
en:
\2Alisa, the Thinly Clad Woman:\F
\s  The monsters here turn on a whim.\w\s One
 minute they're friendly with the guards, the
 next they're hacking away at each other.\s\e

zh:
\2【一副賢者樣子的男子：庫諾翰】\F
\s　　你知道「十賢者寶石」這種珍奇的寶物嗎\o？\w\s只要你
　收集得到１０個像火燄般猛烈燃燒的紅蓮寶石\o，\w\s聽說…
　就會有什麼好事情發生喔\o。\s\e
en:
\2Kunohan, the Sagely Man:\F
\s  Ever heard of a rare treasure called the
 "Ten Sages' Gems"?\w\s They say if you gather
 10 Crimson Lotus Gems that blaze like fire,
 then...\w\s something good will happen.\s\e

zh:
\2【瘋狂的男子：阿祥】\F
\s　　咈咈\o。\w\s…咈咈咯咯咯\o、\w\s哈哈哈、哈哈哈哈哈\o！\w\s真好
　笑\o、\w\s太好笑了\o！\w\s這個痞子\o、\w\s那個王八\o、\w\s通通死光光了\o！\k\c\w\s　我也死翹翹了\o……。\w
\s　　對對對\o、\w\s你～也差不多快死了\o。\w
\s　十字架\o、\w\s十字架靠…靠過來了…\o、\w\s唔…不要\o…。\e
en:
\2Hsiang, the Madman:\F
\s  Heh heh.\w\s ...Heh heh, hee hee hee, ha ha ha,
 ha ha ha ha!\w\s So funny, too funny!\w\s That
 lout, that bastard, all dead, every last one!\k\c\w\s I'm dead too...\w
\s  Yes, yes, yes, and you'll be dead soon too~\w
\s The cross, the cross is c-coming closer...\w\s
 ugh... no...\e

zh:
\2【戴著眼鏡的女子：瑪麗】\F
\s　　聽說…\o、\w\s緋王…\o、\w\s抱歉\o、\w\s我這麼說實在有點失禮\o。\w\s應
　該說理查國王所擁有的名劍也就是「王者之劍」\o、\w\s就
　長眠在這地牢中未知的深處\o。\w\s沒記錯的話…\u\k\c　我記得守衛時常很得意的告訴我說，那把劍其實是給
　封印住了\o。\w\s\k\c　　地點嘛\o…\w\s對了\o、\w\s只要靜下來仔細聽，應該就會明
　白的\o。\w\s當然、如果你還記得住旋律的話…\u
　\s它應該就在那個會響起令人懷念樂曲所在的地方\o。\e
en:
\2Marie, the Bespectacled Woman:\F
\s  They say... the Scarlet King... forgive me,
 that's rude.\w\s\k\c  I mean, King Richard's sword, the "King's
 Sword", sleeps deep within this dungeon.\w\s\k\c  If I remember right, the guards often
 bragged to me that the sword is really sealed
 away.\w\s\k\c  Where is it?\w\s Oh yes, listen quietly and
 you'll know.\w\s If you remember the tune...\u
\s It must be where a nostalgic melody plays.\e

zh: \2【衛兵】\F\n　\s有人逃走了！\e
en: \2Guard:\F\n \sSomeone's escaped!\e

zh: \n\2　　　　【開啟水閘才能得到你想要的】\F\e
en: \n\2  Open the sluice gate to get what you seek\F\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　　　【水閘啟動裝置】\F\e
en: \n\2             Sluice Gate Control\F\e

zh:
\2【瘦弱憔悴的男子】\F
\o　\w…\w…\w…\w…\w\s終於…終於輪到我要被處死了\o。\s\w
啊\o、\s不是來殺我的\o？\w…\w…\w\s怎麼會\o、\s\w這是夢吧\o？\s等等\o、\s\w你們…
真的是來救我出去的嗎\o？\s\w謝\o、\s\w謝謝你們的大恩大德\o。\s\w\u\k\c　如果我真的能夠活著出去，這份恩情一定會報答你們
的\o，\s\w這點小小心意請你們務必收下\o。\e
en:
\2Gaunt Man:\F
\w......\w\sAt last... at last it's my turn to die.\s\w
Oh, not here to kill me?\w......\w\s It can't be.
Is this a dream?\s Wait,\s\w you came to free me?\k\cTh-thank you for your great kindness.\s\w
 If I really get out of here alive, I'll repay
this debt.\s\w Please, you must accept this token.\e

zh:
\2【暴牙男】\F
　\s穴穴你們救我區來\o。\s\w做份心意還請
笑納\o。\s\w請你們務必縮下\o。\s\w
　希望\o、\s\w我們彼楚都能活著離開做裡，到外陀相見\o。\s\w\u　加油吧、好兄弟\o！\e
en:
\2Bucktoothed Man:\F
 \sThankth for gettin' me out.\s\w Pleathe accept
thith little gift.\s\w You mutht take it.\s\w\k\c I hope we both get out of thith plathe alive
and meet again outthide.\s\w
 Hang in there, brother!\e

zh: \4\n　　　　　突然四周響起了警鈴告急的聲響！\e
en: \4\n   Suddenly an alarm rings out all around!\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　〔禁止進入區域〕\n　　未經許可者禁止啟動牆上的控制開關\e
en: \n            -- Restricted Area --\n    Wall switch: authorized personnel only\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　〔巡邏警衛室〕\e
en: \n          -- Patrol Guards' Room --\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　　　〔倉庫〕\e
en: \n               -- Storeroom --\e

zh: \2【盜墓王：艾克】\F\n\s　　唷～…\o、\w\s真是抱歉得很\o，\w\s這裡所有的寶物已經被我\n　全包下來了\o。\w\s呀呵～～！這整座寶山\o，\w\s可把我樂死了\o！\e
en:
\2Ike the Grave King:\F
\s  Yo~...\w\s Real sorry, but every treasure in
 here's already spoken for.\w\s Yahoo~! A whole
 mountain of loot, I could die happy!\e

zh: \n\n　　　　　　－－封閉中－－\e
en: \n\n                -- Sealed --\e

zh: \n　無關緊要者請儘速由此地區離去。\n　　　東區十分危險，禁止進入\o。\e
en: \n  All non-essential persons, leave at once.\n   East sector dangerous. Entry forbidden.\e

zh: \n　　　　『招來災厄的魔女禁閉於此』\e
en: \n  'Here is held the witch who brings calamity'\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　東\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2east\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　西\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2west\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　南\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2south\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　北\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2north\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　東南\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2southeast\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　西南\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2southwest\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　東北\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2northeast\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　西北\F方的牆壁好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n    The \2northwest\F wall seems to have shifted.\e

zh: \n　　　　這道鐵欄好像可以用\2『牢房鑰匙』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  These bars look like they can be opened\n  with the \2'Rusty Cell Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　這道鐵欄好像可以用\2『銀之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  These bars look like they can be opened\n  with the \2'Silver Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　這道鐵欄好像可以用\2『紅寶石之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  These bars look like they can be opened\n  with the \2'Ruby Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　這道鐵欄好像可以用\2『龍之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  These bars look like they can be opened\n  with the \2'Ornate Dragon Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　這道鐵欄上沒有鎖頭\e
en: \n        There is no lock on these bars.\e

zh: \n　　　　　這扇門好像可以用\2『牢房鑰匙』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  This door looks like it can be opened\n  with the \2'Rusty Cell Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　　這扇門好像可以用\2『銀之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  This door looks like it can be opened\n  with the \2'Silver Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　這扇門好像可以用\2『紅寶石之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  This door looks like it can be opened\n  with the \2'Ruby Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　這扇門好像可以用\2『龍之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n  This door looks like it can be opened\n  with the \2'Ornate Dragon Key'\F.\e

zh: \n　　　　這扇門好像需要什麼特殊的鑰匙才能打開\e
en: \n  This door seems to need some special key\n  to open it.\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　這扇門上沒有鎖頭\e
en: \n        There is no lock on this door.\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　鎖頭已經完全腐爛了\e
en: \n      The lock has rotted away completely.\e

zh:
\2　　　　　　　【　　特別警告！　】\F\k\c　\2下一關配置\F：部隊１＝區域‧０００Ａ
　　　　　　　：部隊２＝區域‧０００Ｂ
　　　　　　　：部隊３＝區域‧０００Ｃ\k\c　各區間無法以一般的方法往來行動
　　　　　　地牢總管　\2傑達恩\F\e
en:
\2              SPECIAL WARNING!\F\k\c \2Next floor deployment\F: Unit 1 = Area 000A
                      : Unit 2 = Area 000B
                      : Unit 3 = Area 000C\k\c Movement between areas is impossible by
 ordinary means.
          Dungeon Warden \2Jadain\F\e

zh: 『西可開寶藏之門、東可闢魔法陣之路』\n　　　　　　『爾等所欲往者為何？』\e
en: 'To the west, the door to treasure;\n  to the east, the path to the magic circle.'\n          'Which way will ye go?'\e

zh: \n　　　　　『如光陰之回溯逆行』\n　　　　　　『燃起蠟燭之光』\e
en: \n      'As time flows back upon itself,'\n        'kindle the candle's light.'\e

zh: \n\2『抑制爾等過度的慾望，當可保長命百歲』\F\e
en: \n\2 'Curb your greed, and ye shall live long.'\F\e

zh: \n\2　　　『想看看栩栩如生的雕像嗎？』\F\e
en: \n\2      'Care to see a lifelike statue?'\F\e

zh:
\2【夫人】\F
\s　被關在這裡的人幾乎全給帶到我所不知道的地方
去了…\o。\w
\s　一定…一定都給他們處死了\o\w…\w…\w\s嗚、嗚…\o。\e
en:
\2Lady:\F
\s  Nearly all the people locked up here were
taken off to somewhere I don't know...\o\w
\s  They must... they must all have been
\sexecuted\o\w...\w...\w\s Oh... oh...\o\e

zh:
\2【堅強的女子】\F
\s　你們…你們是…\o？\s\w原來…原來從地底下一路逃到這來
的就是你們\o。\s\k\c\s　現在整個地牢就像捅翻的蜂巢一樣，警衛全傾巢而出了\o。\s\w
　各位可得當心一點…\o。\s\w聽說他們好像驅使了什麼可怕的
怪物要將你們趕盡殺絕的樣子…\o。\e
en:
\2Steadfast Woman:\F
\s  You... you're...\o?\s\w So you two are the ones
who fled all the way here from the depths\o.\s\k\c\s  The Dungeon is a kicked hornets' nest; the
guards have all swarmed out\o.\s\w
  Be careful, both of you...\o\s\w They say some
dreadful monster is being sent to kill you...\o\e

zh:
\2【年輕人】\F
\s　在這附近巡邏的守衛，手上應該會有一把刻有骷髏雕
\s像的鑰匙才對\o。\s\w拿著骷髏鑰匙到北邊一座骸骨雕像，
\s將它插入隱藏在瞳孔的鑰匙孔，牆壁應該就可以打開\o。\u\s你這樣試過了嗎\o？\e
en:
\2Young Man:\F
\s  The guards patrolling near here should
\shave a key carved with a skull\o.\s\w\k\c\s  Take that Skull Key to the skeleton statue
\sto the north and put it in the keyhole hidden
\sin its eye\o.\s\w The wall should open then\o.
\s Have you tried that\o?\e

zh: \n　　骸骨雕像的瞳孔深處可以看到像鑰匙孔的小洞。\e
en: \n  Deep in the skeleton statue's eye is a small\n  hole that looks like a keyhole.\e

zh: \n　『對眼前寶物無所欲者，按下臨近的按鈕吧！』\n　　　『所有的寶物將同塵土般灰飛煙滅。』\e
en:
'If ye want none of the treasure before ye,
  press the button nearby!'
 'All the treasure shall crumble into dust.'\e

zh: \2【夫人】\F\n\s　「傑達恩」這個人是出了名的狡滑傢伙\o。\s\w聽說他會使\n\s用不知名的力量操縱幻術\o。\s\w你們可要當心他一點\o。\s\e
en:
\2Lady:\F
\s  That Jadain is a notoriously sly one\o.
\sThey say he wields some unknown power to
\swork illusions\o.\s\w Be wary of him\o.\s\e

zh:
\2【不屈的男子】\F
\s　地牢總管的「傑達恩」是個擁有奇特力量的人，據說
\s他會使用幻術將放有重要物品的地方偽裝起來，讓你無
\s法察覺\o。\u\s\k\c\s　如果你想從這逃出去，就必須通過他設計的所有卑劣
\s而且困難重重的陷阱不可\o。\s\w
\s　請注意沒什麼東西的地方，鐵定有什麼在那兒\o…\w…\w\s而且這種
\s我敢肯定說地下一層就有這種機關\o。\s\e
en:
\2Unyielding Man:\F
\s  Jadain, the Dungeon Warden, has a strange
\spower. They say he uses illusions to hide
\sthe places where important things are kept\o.\s\w\k\c\s  You'll never notice them\o.\s\w To escape, you
\smust get past every vile and brutal trap he
\shas laid\o.\s\w\k\c\s  Where nothing seems to be, something is
\sthere\o...\w...\w\s I bet the floor below has one\o.\s\e

zh:
附近突然起了什麼響聲。\k\c\2【傑達恩】\F
\s　沒想到你們居然能活著來到這裡\o。\s\w咈咈\o…\s\w我個人是很
\s想讚揚兩位不怕死的勇氣\o。\s\w不過這麼做的話，我的腦袋
\s可就不保了\o。\s\w你們的運氣已經到此為止了\o。\u\s儘管在那做最後垂死的掙吧\o！\s\e
en:
Suddenly, there is a noise nearby.\k\c\2Jadain:\F
\s  So you actually made it here alive\o.\s\w
\sHeh heh\o...\s\w I would love to praise your
\sfearless courage\o.\s\w\k\c\s  But that would cost me my head\o.\s\w Your
\sluck has run out\o.\u\s Go on, thrash about in
\syour death throes\o!\s\e

zh: \n　　　　　　附近突然起了什麼響聲。\k\c\n　　　　　　　　\4「死吧！」\e
en: \n      Suddenly, there is a noise nearby.\k\c\n                  \4"Die!"\e

zh: 『急行不若靜待』\n『觀爾等如螻蟻般仆行緩進之景，人生一樂也』\e
en: 'Better to wait than to hurry.'\n 'Watching ye crawl like ants: a joy of life.'\e

zh: \n　這好像是可以降下某座特定橋樑的開關。從正面可以\n看到有一個像開關的鑰匙孔在上頭。\e
en:
This seems to be a switch that lowers a
certain bridge. On its face you can see a
keyhole that seems to work it.\e

zh:
\2【水精靈】\F
\s　我是棲身在這地底湖中的精靈\o。\s\w最近這裡突然出現
\s了一個自稱為「魅影冰魔」的法師，把我十分重要的項
\s鍊強行奪走了\o。\u\s\k\c\s　因為項鍊給奪走，我也失去法力，整天待在這裡根本
\s動彈不得\o。\s\w
\s　求求你們…\o。\s\w無論如何\o、\s\w能不能請你們幫我把那串項
\s鍊從魅影冰魔手上搶回來\o？\s\e
en:
\2Water Spirit:\F
\s  I am the spirit of this Cavern Lake\o.\s\w
\s  Of late, a sorcerer calling himself the
\s"Ice Phantom" appeared out of nowhere\o.\s\w\k\c\s  He took my precious necklace by force\o.\s\w
\s  With my necklace gone, I have lost my power
\sand cannot leave this spot\o.\s\w\k\c\s  Please...\o\s\w whatever it takes\o,\s\w could you
\swin my necklace back from the Ice Phantom\o?\s\e

zh: \2【水精靈】\F\n\s　請你們幫我把項鍊從魅影冰魔手上搶回來\o。\s\w拜託你們\n\s了\o。\s\w我想他大概就躲藏在這湖裡的什麼地方\o。\s\e
en:
\2Water Spirit:\F
\s  Please win back my necklace from
\sthe Ice Phantom\o.\s\w I beg you\o.\s\w I believe he
\sis hiding somewhere in this lake\o.\s\e

zh: \2【水精靈】\F\n\s　非常感謝你們的協助\o。\s\w為了報答兩位，我把封印在西\n\s南方柱子上的劍送給你們\o。\s\w請兩位務必收下\o。\s\e
en:
\2Water Spirit:\F
\s  Thank you so much for your help\o.\s\w To
\srepay you both, I give you the sword sealed
\sin the pillar to the southwest\o.\s\w Please, do
\saccept it\o.\s\e

zh: \2【水精靈】\F\n\s　非常感謝兩位的幫忙\o。\s你們的恩德，我永遠都不會忘記\n\s的\o。\s\e
en: \2Water Spirit:\F\n\s  Thank you both so much\o.\s I will never forget\n\syour kindness\o.\s\e

zh: \n　大概是錯覺吧，四周溫度好像有點下降的感覺。\e
en: \n  Perhaps it is only your imagination, but the\nair seems to have grown a little colder.\e

zh: \n　附近也吹來陣陣令人屏息的逼人寒氣。看這樣子實\n在有點不太尋常！\e
en: \n  A bitter, breath-stealing cold is blowing in\nfrom nearby as well. Something is not right!\e

zh:
\2【鬼祟的魔法師】\F
\s　聽說棲息在地底湖西側的精靈身上有個可以讓法力只
\s須消耗一半的項鍊……\o。\s\w如果你們可以想辦法將那個
\s寶物弄到手，可不以拿來送給我\o？\s\u\s　我會報答你們的\o。\s\e
en:
\2Shifty Mage:\F
\s  They say the spirit on the west side of the
\sCavern Lake has a necklace that halves the
\smagic you spend...\o\s\w\k\c\s  If you can get your hands on that treasure
\ssomehow, would you bring it to me\o?\s\u\s  I'll make it worth your while\o.\s\e

zh: \2【鬼祟的魔法師】\F\n\s　拜託你們啦\o。\s\w可別放到自己的口袋裡喔\o。\s\e
en: \2Shifty Mage:\F\n\s  I'm counting on you\o.\s\w And don't go slipping\n\sit into your own pocket\o.\s\e

zh: \2【鬼祟的魔法師】\F\n\s　這\o、\s\w這就是傳說中的精靈項鍊嗎\o！\s\w這個送給你們\o。\s\w拿了\n\s就快走吧\o。\s\w\e
en:
\2Shifty Mage:\F
\s  Th\o-\s\wthis is the legendary
\sSpirit Necklace\o!\s\w Here, this is for you\o.
\sTake it and go, quickly\o.\s\w\e

zh: \2【鬼祟的魔法師】\F\n\s還想幹嘛\o？\s\w禮我都已經回了\o！\w…\w…\w\s走走走\o！\s\e
en: \2Shifty Mage:\F\n\sWhat do you want now\o?\s\w I already paid you\o!\n\w...\w...\w\s Go on, get out of here\o!\s\e

zh: \n　　　『骷髏封印將天之使者束縛於此地』\n　　　　　　『請手持我碎其封印』\e
en: \n 'The skull seal binds Heaven's envoy here.'\n    'Take me in hand and break its seal.'\e

zh: \n　　　　\8東側\F的水濱好像架上橋樑的樣子\e
en: \n    A bridge seems to span the \8east\F shore.\e

zh: \n　　　　\8西側\F的水濱好像架上橋樑的樣子\e
en: \n    A bridge seems to span the \8west\F shore.\e

zh: \n　　　　\8西北\F的水濱好像架上橋樑的樣子\e
en: \n A bridge seems to span the \8northwest\F shore.\e

zh: \n　　　　\8東南\F的水濱好像架上橋樑的樣子\e
en: \n A bridge seems to span the \8southeast\F shore.\e

zh:
\2【美麗的貴婦人】\F
\s　從這朝北走有個大廳，如果你們啟動了大廳的某個開
\s關的話\o，\s\w好像就可以進入西北角那個原本沒有辦法進去
\s的小房間\o。\s\w\u　聽說裡頭的寶箱好像藏了什麼寶物的樣子\o\w…\w…。\e
en:
\2Beautiful Lady:\F
\s  If you work a certain switch in the hall
\sto the north\o,\s\w you can apparently get into
\sthe once-sealed little room to the northwest\o.\s\w\k\c  They say the chest inside holds
some treasure\o\w...\w...\e

zh:
\2【年輕人】\F
\s　你看到那些人沒有\o？\s\w看守藍色牡羊石像\o。\s\w正在議論紛
\s紛的那一群人。知道他們談些什麼嗎\o？\s\w\k\c\s　我也是聽來的\o，\s\w聽說那具平時靜悄悄的石像，有時候
\s會發出令人毛骨悚然的呻吟聲…\o。\e
en:
\2Young Man:\F
\s  See those people\o?\s\w The ones guarding the
\sblue ram statue\o.\s\w Know what they're muttering
\sabout\o?\s\w\k\c\s  I only heard it secondhand\o,\s\w but they
\ssay that statue, quiet most of the time,
\ssometimes lets out a bloodcurdling moan...\o\e

zh: \n\2　　　　東南\F方的柱子好像起了什麼變化\e
en: \n  The \2southeast\F pillar seems to have changed.\e

zh: \2【簡易妖魔博物館】\F\n\s　　歡迎光臨\o。\w\s敬請各位來賓自由參觀\e
en: \2Simple Demon Museum:\F\n\s  Welcome\o.\w\s Please feel free to browse.\e

zh:
\2【史萊姆Ⅱ’】　　水果凍科：史萊姆目\F
　　屬於果凍狀生物的一種。擁有人類幼兒期程度的
　智能。一般在史萊姆的體表上可看到像瞳孔或口的\k\c　部份，應屬於皮膚硬化後的身體特徵，所以不能把它
　當做特殊的器官。體表顏色多呈綠色。
　　最近由於遺傳因子突然產生異變的關係，身體的透
　明度有越加顯著的趨向。\e
en:
\2Slime II':  Fruit Jelly Family, Slime Order\F
  A jelly-like creature with the intelligence
 of a human toddler. The eye- or mouth-like\k\c parts seen on its surface are only hardened
 skin, not true organs. It is usually green.
  A recent sudden mutation is making its body
 more and more transparent.\e

zh:
\2【泡泡史萊姆】　　水果凍科：史萊姆目\F
　　屬於果凍狀生物的一種。是史萊姆的突變種，由
　於體內水分含有量十分稀少的關係，因此只能生存\k\c　在淡水中。體表顏色多呈藍色。但是一旦死亡後色素
　會沉澱而變成綠色，所以和史萊姆Ⅱ’的屍體比較
　時，很難區別得出來。\e
en:
\2Bubble Slime:  Fruit Jelly Family, Slime Order\F
  A jelly-like creature: a mutant slime. Its
 body holds so little water that it can only\k\c live in fresh water. It is usually blue, but
 on death its pigment settles and it turns
 green, so its corpse is hard to tell apart
 from that of a Slime II'.\e

zh:
\2【歐尼克鳥】　未知科：未知目\F
　　神秘的生物。目前除了瞭解牠是一種高智慧動物外，
　骨格構造及遺傳因子似乎偏向於鳥類的型態。不過\k\c　由於這種生物堅決否認自己是鳥的緣故，因此目前
　還無法分類。曾經有一陣子被認為與尼克鳥有血緣
　的關係，其實仔細一看才知道那是因為牠們從頭部\k\c　到背上的鋸齒紋路實在很像。但就這相似點而言，
　歐尼克鳥仍然堅決不予承認。\e
en:
\2Onick Bird:  Unknown Family, Unknown Order\F
  A mysterious creature.\k\c All that is known is that it is highly
 intelligent; its skeleton and genes seem
 close to a bird's.\k\c However, as it flatly denies being a bird, it
 cannot yet be classified.\k\c It was once thought to be related to the Nick
 Bird, but a closer look showed only that
 their sawtooth stripes from head to back\k\c are much alike. Even that, the Onick Bird
 flatly refuses to admit.\e

zh:
\2【木偶人★】　奴隸科：玩偶目\F
　　這是傀儡師窮畢生之精力創造出來，並賜予其魂魄
　的一種人型木偶。平時一副戴著怪帽子、腳還長在\k\c　臉上的模樣，後腦勺一撮頭髮（看來不像尾巴的樣
　子），有時候也會因為低下頭而甩到前面來。
　　由於木偶人★的個性似乎跟製作者本身當時的心情\k\c　有密切的關連，因此性格上有忽冷忽熱的傾向。\e
en:
\2Puppet*:  Slave Family, Doll Order\F
  A humanoid wooden doll that the Doll Master
 made with all his life's strength and gave a\k\c soul. It wears an odd hat, its feet grow out
 of its face, and the tuft of hair on the back
 of its head (it does not look like a tail)\k\c sometimes flops forward when it looks down.
  Its temper seems closely tied to its maker's
 mood at the time, so it runs hot and cold.\e

zh:
\2【三頭火獸】　魔獸科：三頭火獸目\F
　　這是一種擁有獅子、羊、龍的頭部，獅身上又長出
　一對蝙蝠翅膀、還有一條毒蛇尾巴的怪物。本身有\k\c　石化能力，雖然智慧等級不算很高，但是卻可以使
　用類似幻術的魔力。一般說來，牠應該是一種汲汲於
　每日營生的市井小民一生都不會碰到的生物。但是\k\c　　如果你運氣真的太好，哪天不小心碰到的時候，
　那麼那一天也就是你生命旅途中被劃上句點的日子
　了。
　　這麼個幸運兒？？該不會就是你吧。\e
en:
\2Chimera:  Magic Beast Family, Chimera Order\F
  A monster with the heads of a lion, a goat
 and a dragon, bat wings on its lion's body\k\c and a venomous serpent for a tail. It can
 petrify, and though not very bright, it uses
 magic much like illusion.\k\c Ordinary folk scraping a living day to day
 never meet one.\k\c  But if you are truly too lucky and meet one
 some day, that day will be the day your
 life's journey comes to a full stop.
  And this lucky soul?? Surely not you.\e

zh: \2【盜墓王艾克】\F\n\s　　幹嘛～？你這傢伙真囉嗦。滾一邊兒去！\e
en: \2Ike the Grave King:\F\n\s    Wha~t? You're a real pest. Get lost!\e

zh: \n有一座石像\e
en: \nThere is a stone statue.\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　『沉睡中的敵人』\e
en: \n             'The Sleeping Enemy'\e

zh: \n　　　　　　『與其有時間在一旁抓狂』\n　　　　『不如把頭殼Ｋ到粉碎為止』\e
en: \n    'Instead of throwing a fit over there,'\n    'bash that noggin till it shatters.'\e

zh: 『鞭擊死者使開其口』\n　　　　　『形體朦朧糢糊之蒼白亡靈啊』\n　『爾可逾越枯朽之形骸，引導我等步入未竟之地』\e
en:
'Whip the dead to open their mouths.'
     'O pale ghost of dim and hazy form,'
 'pass beyond the withered husk, and lead us
  on to the land not yet reached.'\e

zh:
\2【老人】\F
\s　分佈在這一層的怪物全都是幻影\o。所以你怎麼打都打不死
牠們的\o。\k\c\s懂了沒\o？\s\w不是什麼事都可以靠蠻力解決得了的\o\w…\w…。\k\c
　把該說的都說完了之後，老人就像煙霧一樣地消失得無
影無蹤了。\e
en:
\2Old Man:\F
\s  Every monster on this floor is a phantom\o.
Hit them all you like, they won't die\o.\k\c\s Understand\o?\s\w Not everything can be
settled by brute force\o\w...\w...\k\c
  Having said all he had to say, the old man
vanished like smoke, without a trace.\e

zh: \2【傑達恩】\F\n\s　沒想到你們還能活著來到這\o。\s\w也好\o、\s\w就讓我親自出馬\n來收拾你們吧\o！\e
en: \2Jadain:\F\n\s  I never thought you'd make it here alive\o.\n\sVery well\o,\s\w I shall finish you off myself\o!\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　　　【狼之巢】\e
en: \n                 The Wolf's Den\e

zh: \n【下午茶　休息時間】\n\s　辛苦了、休息一下吧。\e
en: \n       Afternoon Tea -- Break Time\n\s Good work. Take a break.\e

zh:
\s\2　石版上雖然記載了眼前機器的使用操作說明，但是\o、\s\w
有些文字已經無法辨視\o。\w\k\c\F　這個裝置主要的用途可分為下列２種。
　　　‧用途１　毒針陷阱的啟■／停止
　　　‧用途２　★●▲的停●\k\c
　另外、裝置的啟動／停●等切換動作，必需利用★▲的
　寶石之光才能進行。\e
en:
\s\2 The stone tablet explains how to operate the
machine before you,\o \s\wbut some of its letters
can no longer be read.\o\w\k\c\F This device has two main uses:
    - Use 1: Act#vate/stop the poison needles
    - Use 2: St#p the *#%\k\c
 Also, to switch the device on or st#p it, the
 light of the *% gem is required.\e

zh: \n　　『小心謹慎啊！一步錯滿盤皆輸』\n　　　　　　　『巧妙地閃避陷阱吧』\e
en: \n 'Take care! One false step, and all is lost.'\n         'Deftly evade the traps.'\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　　『隱身吧！』\e
en: \n             'Become invisible!'\e

zh: \n　　『其人於火中漫舞，猶尚如魚得水』\e
en: \n 'That one dances amid the flames as a fish\n  swims in water.'\e

zh: \n　『來者慎之！所有近火燄者將悉數喪失生命。』\n『即使屬於火性者亦難以抗衡火燄之吞食肆虐。』\e
en:
'Beware, ye who come! All who draw near the
  flames shall lose their lives.'\k\c
 'Even creatures of fire cannot withstand the
  flames as they devour and rage.'\e

zh: \2　　　　　　　『爾等應穿越魔界之門』\F\n　　『爾等即使自信不疑，仍需再次觀察眼前之敵』\n　　　『火燄王者之命焉有任火性者奪走之理邪』\e
en:
\2     'Ye must pass through the gate of
           the Demon Realm.'\F\k\c 'However sure ye may be, look once more upon
  the foe before you.'
 'How could one of fire ever take the life of
  the King of Flames?'\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　　　『無限地獄』\e
en: \n              'Endless Inferno'\e

zh: \n　　　『俯視其下。必有寶箱可見』\e
en: \n 'Look down below. A treasure chest shall be\n  seen.'\e

zh: \n　如果有什麼東西可以消滅這股力量，火燄就會消失吧。\e
en: \n If something could destroy this power, the\n flames would vanish.\e

zh: \n　如果有什麼東西可以消滅這股力量，火燄就會消失吧？\e
en: \n If something could destroy this power, would\n the flames vanish?\e

zh:
『鞭擊死者使開其口』
『即便魂魄已銷，尚留形骸於世間之亡者啊』
『今賜其假死之短暫生命』
『遂能聽命於持有冥界魔鑰之爾等』\e
en:
'Whip the dead to open their mouths.'
'O dead whose souls are spent, yet whose husks
 remain in this world,'\k\c'I now grant ye a brief, borrowed life,'
'that ye may obey those who hold the dread key
 of the Netherworld.'\e

zh: \n　『抱我於聖母艾翠西亞之懷中，彈之以輕柔』\e
en: \n 'Hold me in the arms of the Holy Mother\n  Aetricia, and play me gently.'\e

zh: \n　　　『無形之障壁，是為邁向勝利之礎石』\e
en: \n 'An unseen barrier is the cornerstone of\n  victory.'\e

zh: \2　　　　　　『爾等應穿越魔界之門』\F\n　遇雙門時，當可立即判斷此為爾等藉由此地\n　　　　瞬間運往彼處之傳送通路\e
en:
\2     'Ye must pass through the gate of
           the Demon Realm.'\F\k\c When ye meet twin doors, know at once that
 they are passages that carry ye in an instant
 from this place to another.\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　有一座腐蝕頹朽的石像\e
en: \n      There is a corroded, crumbling statue.\e

zh: \n　　　『每次只能一個人…然後安靜地…』\e
en: \n   'Only one at a time... and quietly...'\e

zh: \n　看來蛇妖梅杜莎的咀咒已經被解放的樣子。\e
en: \n It seems the curse of Medusa the Lamia has\n been lifted.\e

zh: \2【鬼祟的魔法師】\F\n\s　照貧道的推算來看嘛…\o，\w\s如何節制使用身邊的復活藥\n劑，將是你們達成目的的重要關鍵\o。\s\e
en:
\2Shifty Mage:\F
\s By this humble one's reckoning...\o\w\s
how sparingly you use the revival potions you
carry will be the key to reaching your goal.\o\s\e

zh:
\2【傀儡師】\F
\s　我所衷愛的\o「\s木偶人\o」\s和\o「\s雪莉兒\o」\s是多麼相思相愛
的一對啊\o。\w\s你們瞧\o、\w\s他們很可愛吧\o？\w\s
　為了給予他們倆永久的生命\o、\w\s我要你們\o…\w\s死～\o！\e
en:
\2Doll Master:\F
\s My beloved "Puppet" and "Cheryl"...\o what a
pair of lovebirds they are!\o\w\s Look at them,
aren't they adorable?\o\w\s\k\c To give the two of them eternal life,\o\w\s
I need you\o...\w\s to DIE\o!\e

zh: \n　『世間的跳樑小丑啊，爾等自嘲者未免過甚』\e
en: \n 'O ye clowns capering about the world, ye\n  mock yourselves far too much.'\e

zh:
\2【小丑木偶人☆】\F
\s　我心目中的情人\o「\s雪莉兒\o」\s離我而去，她再也不會回
到我身邊了\o。\w\s剛才我聽到附近傳來她的悲號\o。\w\s
　我懂了\o…\w\s是你們害的\o！\w\s納命來吧\o！\e
en:
\2Clown Puppet:\F
\s My sweetheart "Cheryl" has left me, and
she'll never come back to me.\o\w\s Just now I
heard her scream nearby.\o\w\s\k\c I see\o...\w\s you did this\o!\w\s
 Your lives are mine\o!\e

zh: 『鑑定眼前之真偽』\n　　『幻者為虛，以劍揮之者魂飛魄散』\e
en: 'Judge the true and the false before you.'\n 'Phantoms are hollow: strike one with a sword\n  and it shall scatter, soul and all.'\e

zh: \n　　　　　　　『求死不得者速來此』\e
en: \n 'Ye who seek death and cannot find it, come\n  hither with haste.'\e

zh: \n　　　　　　『獻祭三次得以求我』\e
en: \n  'Offer sacrifice thrice, and ye may call\n   upon me.'\e

zh: \n\s　謝謝你們解放了我們。\e
en: \n\s Thank you for freeing us.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　　　　　【二擇其一】\F\e
en: \n\2               Choose One\F\e

zh:
\2　　『曾經蒙受英雄豪傑之幻影所保護的傳說之劍』
　『以緋王之名更改其名及形體並封印於此』\w\u\k\c
　　　『倘有冠緋王之名且擁有悉數魔石者前來』
　　『握擁\3　王者之劍\2　之權利應賦予其人勿誤』\w\u\k\c
　　　　　　　　『獻魔石於雕像之上吧』
　　　　『爾等期望之大道將一步一步地開啟』\w\u\k\e
en:
\2 'The sword of legend, once guarded by the
  phantoms of heroes,'\w\k\c 'was renamed and reshaped in the Scarlet
  King's name, and sealed in this place.'\w\k\c 'Should one who bears the Scarlet King's
  name and holds every magic stone come,'\w\k\c 'the right to wield \3the King's Sword\2 shall
  be granted to that one without fail.'\w\k\c 'Offer the magic stones upon the statue,'
 'and the road ye seek shall open, step by
  step.'\w\u\k\e

zh: \n　　　　這道鐵欄好像可以用\2『蛇之鑰』\F打開的樣子\e
en: \n These bars look like they can be opened\n with the \2'Serpent Key'\F.\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　　　　　【透視可也】\F\e
en: \n\2           Thou Mayst See Through\F\e

zh: \n\2　　　　　　　　【覺悟之可乎？】\F\e
en: \n\2            Art Thou Prepared?\F\e

zh:
\s　　各位玩家們好\o。\w\s我是緋王傳Ⅱ’代中擔任企劃的
　ＭＫＧ先生\o。\w\s如果照當初預定\o，\w\s本來是要用『狼之
　巢』這個名稱來做為製作小組中每個人發表個人感
　言或心得的特別專欄的\o，\w\s但是由於磁片容量不夠的\u　關係，只好忍痛取消\o。\s\u\k\c　　在此個人僅代表所有伙伴為各位透露遊戲中的秘技
　並簡單介紹每一位製作小組成員\o。\s\k\c　　大家一定在想\o，\w\s緋王傳Ⅱ會有啥秘技\o？\w\s
　其實在第一關的時候，就隱藏著一個可以使所有怪
　物都加入我方的超級秘技\o。\w\s這個方法就是\o…\w\o…\k\e
en:
\s  Hello, players.\o\w\s I'm MKG, the planner on
 Hiouden II.\o\w\k\c\s  Originally we planned a special column,
 'The Wolf's Den', where everyone on the team
 would share their thoughts and impressions.\o\k\c\w\s  But there wasn't enough disk space, so we
 had to cut it. It broke our hearts.\o\s\k\c  So here, on behalf of all my teammates, I'll
 let you in on a secret trick in the game, and
 briefly introduce each member of the team.\o\s\k\c  I bet you're all wondering,\o \w\swhat secret
 tricks could Hiouden II possibly have?\o\w\s\k\c  Well, hidden in stage one is a super trick
 that makes every monster join your side.\o\w\s
 And here's how\o...\w\o...\k\e

zh:
\s　　\o【重新開始遊戲】\s這項選擇了以後\o，\w\s先按住鍵盤上的
　\o〔ＣＴＲＬ〕鍵\s並按住滑鼠右邊的按鍵，這樣持續按
　著，直到遊戲開始之後就應該ＯＫ了\o。\s\k\c　　接下來我將對製作小組\o（依我個人的觀點）\s做一
　番簡單的介紹\o。\w\s不過因為資料量的關係，沒辦法
　每個人都介紹到\o…\w…\s嗚咽\o！\k\c\s　　還好結尾製作群介紹時還看得到他們\o（感謝上蒼）。\w\s
　　那麼\o、\w\s就開始介紹他們吧。\k\e
en:
\s  After you choose \o'New Game'\s,\o\w\s
 hold down the \o'CTRL' key\s on the keyboard
 and the right mouse button.\w\k\c Keep holding both until the game starts, and
 you're all set.\o\s\k\c  Next, I'll give a quick introduction to the
 team \o(from my own point of view)\s.\o\w\k\c\s But there isn't room in the data, so I can't
 introduce everyone\o...\w...\s *sob*\o!\k\c\s  Luckily you can still see them all in the
 ending credits \o(thank heavens).\w\s
  Well then,\o \w\slet's begin the introductions.\k\e

zh:
ˍ》ＪＯＥ淺沼
　　狼組的頭頭，也就是第一號大頭目。首先冒險犯
　　難提出開發硬碟版的人也是他。\k\c
　　所以大家應該感謝他的雞婆。\k\c　　》稻毛叔叔（可別把他當老頭看喔～）
　　主要技術的負責人。敬業樂群甚至為緋王傳Ⅱ’
　　鞠躬盡瘁而死。真是令人涕淚亂舞。\k\c　ˍ》小澤先生
　　鬼才程式師。能力強到可以用程式將現世跟魔界
　　串聯在一起。呃、隨便說說可別當真。\k\c　ˍ》三宅先生
　　也是程式師。有關戰鬥、魔法方面的ＡＩ都是由
　　他負責。不過聽寫繞跑的ＡＩ時差點嗝屁。\k\e
en:
> Joe Asanuma
   Wolf Team's head honcho, boss number one.\k\c
   He's also the one who braved the risk and
   first proposed a hard-disk version.\k\c
   So be grateful for his meddling, everyone.\k\c > Uncle Inage (don't you call him old~)
   Lead on the core tech. So devoted that he
   worked himself to death for Hiouden II.\k\c
   It's enough to make you weep buckets.\k\c > Ozawa
   Genius programmer. So good he could code a
   link between our world and the Demon Realm.\k\c
   Er, just kidding. Don't take it seriously.\k\c > Miyake
   Another programmer. He did all the battle
   and magic AI.\k\c
   Though rumour has it the
   pathing AI nearly killed him.\k\e

zh:
ˍ》磯谷先生
　　偉大的美工。事實上有關地圖和怪物的部份，幾
　　乎都是他一個人幹掉的，值得冒汗吧。\k\c　ˍ》櫻庭先生
　　配樂作曲者。為我們的緋王傳Ⅱ寫了許多不少動
　　聽悅耳的曲子。個人非常喜歡他的風格。\k\c　特別介紹》阿廣
　　雜工助手。除了幫忙繪製硬碟版中的地形元素，
　　還忙著其它瑣碎的工作，很像章魚吧。\k\c
【ＭＫＧ】\s　各位玩到這裡\o，\w\s遊戲還有１／３路程\o。\w\s請各
　　　　　　位繼續加油吧\o。\w\s\e
en:
> Isogai
   Our great artist. In truth, nearly all the
   maps and monsters were done by him alone.\k\c
   Makes you sweat just thinking about it.\k\c > Sakuraba
   Composer. He wrote a whole lot of lovely
   tunes for our Hiouden II.\k\c
   I'm a big fan of his style myself.\k\c Special mention: Hiro
   Odd-job man.\k\c   Besides drawing terrain pieces for the
   hard-disk version, he does lots of little
   jobs. Quite an octopus, isn't he?\k\c
MKG:\s You've made it this far,\o\w\s and one
     third of the game is left.\o\w\s
     Keep at it, everyone!\o\w\s\e
